title: Hearty Spicy Egyptian Minari Tagine
description: A spicy and chewy Egyptian dish featuring minari, soffritto-base, and satvik-friendly ingredients, evoking nostalgic feelings with its rich flavors.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large clay or ceramic tagine or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until they are translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for another minute, stirring constantly.
Add the crushed tomatoes, red pepper flakes, cumin, coriander, and salt, and stir to combine.
Add the minari and stir to combine, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Stir the tagine occasionally to prevent the minari from sticking to the bottom of the pot.
After 20 minutes, remove the lid and continue to simmer for another 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
